title: Compare the type and value at the same time when checking the number
goal: Use === to prevent different types of device numbers from being regarded as the same number.
summary: Old records are numbered using numbers, new records are numbered using text. The synchronization tool only recognizes numbers with the same value and type.
tasks: completes sameSerial(left, right). Returns true if the two numbers are identical, otherwise returns false.
The string "7" is not considered the same as the number 7; leading zeros in the string should be preserved.

example.note: Strict equality does not automatically convert one type to another before comparing.

hint: directly returns left === right. Do not convert to a number or string first.
